sources.title: newton-adhikari/multi_model_sensor_fusion - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a real-time sensor fusion system using LiDAR, RGB camera, and IMU data to estimate the pose and trajectory of a mobile platform. The fusion is achieved via a manually implemented Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) in ROS2 using Python and NumPy.
